hero_title: Emergency medical care for Saida, whenever it's needed
hero_sub: Based in Saida, we run a volunteer paramedic and ambulance service, lending medical equipment to families who can't afford it and responding to emergencies day and night.
intro_body: Based in Saida, Lebanon, the Islamic Medical Association coordinates ambulance missions, paramedic teams, and a free medical-equipment lending program for families in need. Every response and every loan is logged so we can keep the service accountable and reliable.
volunteer_cta_body: We're always looking for paramedics, drivers and logistics volunteers.
donate_cta_title: Help us keep the ambulances running
donate_cta_body: Every donation covers fuel, medical supplies and equipment maintenance.
footer_tagline: A volunteer-run healthcare response network based in Saida, Lebanon.
about_mission_b: To make emergency medical response and essential medical equipment available to every household in our service area, regardless of ability to pay.
about_vision_b: A community where no family waits too long for an ambulance or goes without a wheelchair, oxygen concentrator or hospital bed.
about_values_b: Accountability, dignity, rapid response, and community trust.
volunteer_body: We rely on volunteer paramedics, drivers, and logistics support. If you'd like to help, send us a message and our team will get back to you about current openings and training requirements.

services_list_b: A dispatched paramedic crew and ambulance for medical emergencies across our coverage area.
Oxygen concentrators, wheelchairs, hospital beds and other equipment loaned free of charge to households in need.
Follow-up visits for patients who need monitoring after a mission or hospital discharge.
Basic first-aid and emergency-response sessions for community members and local volunteers.
